description: 2019 Nissan Pathfinder FWD S  3.5L V-6 gasoline direct injection, DOHC, variable valve control with 284 HP paired to an Xtronic CVT; a capable family SUV that balances V6 power with efficient highway manners and everyday drivability.  Forward collision mitigation helps the vehicle anticipate and respond when traffic suddenly slows, engaging protective systems to reduce the chance or severity of a front-end collision so you and your passengers feel safer on busy roads.  The rear camera gives an expanded view behind the vehicle, making parking and reversing more confident by revealing obstacles and improving awareness where mirrors cant reach.  Brake assist senses urgent braking and supplements your input with additional stopping power, helping you bring the Pathfinder to a quicker, more controlled halt in emergencies.  Cruise control with steering wheel controls lets you set and maintain highway speeds without taking your hands off the wheel, reducing fatigue on long drives and helping steady fuel consumption.  A responsive touchscreen consolidates key controls and info under your fingertips, making infotainment and settings simple to use while keeping attention on the road.  Fixed third-row seating provides permanent, ready-to-use passenger capacity so families and groups can travel together without the hassle of constantly stowing and deploying seats.  Variable valve timing adjusts engine behavior across different rev ranges, delivering smoother low-speed manners and stronger high-end performance while improving efficiency.  The DOHC valvetrain supports higher engine speeds and better breathing, translating into a livelier power delivery and more responsive acceleration when you need it.  Gasoline direct injection optimizes fuel delivery for stronger throttle response and improved economy compared with older injection systems, giving the V6 both punch and efficiency.  Keyfob window control lets you lower the windows remotely to cool the cabin before you enter, adding a small but meaningful convenience on hot days.  A proximity key with push-button start removes the need to fumble for keys  unlock, hop in, and start the engine while the fob stays in your pocket for a seamless entry and go experience.  Practical and thoughtfully equipped, this Pathfinder S pairs V6 smoothness with family-focused convenience and safety aids that make daily driving easier. If you want a roomy, reliable SUV with straightforward tech and useful driver assists, schedule a test drive to experience how it handles real-world needs. description: The 2022 Dodge Challenger GT is a modern American muscle car that blends iconic styling, confident performance, advanced technology, and everyday comfort into one exciting package. With its unmistakable retro-inspired design and powerful V6 performance, the Challenger GT delivers the classic muscle car experience while offering refined driving dynamics and modern convenience. Whether cruising through the city or taking on the open highway, the Challenger GT offers an engaging and comfortable ride with timeless appeal.  Powered by a proven 3.6 liter Pentastar V6 engine producing 303 horsepower and 268 lb-ft of torque, the Challenger GT delivers strong acceleration, smooth power delivery, and impressive fuel efficiency for a muscle car. Paired with a responsive eight-speed TorqueFlite automatic transmission, the powertrain provides quick, seamless shifts and confident performance in a variety of driving conditions. Available all-wheel drive on select models further enhances traction and year-round capability.  The exterior styling of the 2022 Challenger GT is bold, aggressive, and unmistakably Dodge. Featuring the signature split grille, functional hood scoop, LED halo headlights, sculpted body lines, dual exhaust outlets, performance-inspired front fascia, and stylish 20-inch alloy wheels, the Challenger GT carries the unmistakable presence of a true American muscle car while honoring its legendary heritage.  Inside the cabin, the Challenger GT offers a spacious and driver-focused interior with premium materials and exceptional comfort. Performance-inspired cloth seating with available leather and suede inserts, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, power-adjustable driver's seat, and generous passenger space make the Challenger one of the most comfortable coupes in its class. The large trunk and fold-flat rear seats add practicality for everyday use.  Technology is one of the Challenger GT's strongest highlights. Equipped with the Uconnect infotainment system featuring a large touchscreen display, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, SiriusXM capability, multiple USB ports, voice recognition, steering wheel-mounted controls, premium audio options, and remote start, the Challenger keeps drivers connected and entertained on every journey.  Performance features include Sport Mode, performance-tuned suspension, responsive steering, four-wheel disc brakes, traction control, stability control, and selectable driving modes that enhance driver confidence while maintaining a comfortable ride for everyday commuting.  Safety is another major strength. Advanced features include Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Cross Path Detection, ParkSense Rear Park Assist, a rearview camera, Electronic Stability Control, Brake Assist, multiple airbags, and a reinforced high-strength steel safety cage designed to provide confidence and protection.  Owners consistently praise the 2022 Dodge Challenger GT for its iconic styling, comfortable interior, smooth V6 performance, modern technology, and everyday drivability. Its combination of muscle car heritage, spacious cabin, and refined road manners makes it one of the most practical and enjoyable coupes in its segment.  The 2022 Dodge Challenger GT is the perfect choice for drivers looking for classic American muscle, dependable V6 performance, advanced technology, and everyday comfort in one complete package. description: The 2022 Ford Escape S greets you with a calm, inviting atmosphere the moment you slip into the Dark Earth Gray interior. This SUV's thoughtfully contoured cloth seats and well-damped controls set the tone for a refined drive, enhanced by the subtle tactility of its soft-touch surfaces.  This SUV is an ideal match for buyers who prioritize everyday refinement, comfort, and understated quality over flash. With 63,125 miles on the odometer, it offers proven value and enduring sophistication - perfect for those who appreciate classic amenities and a feature-rich environment. In places like St. Louis, where weather and traffic demand a practical yet pleasant ride, this Escape S stands out for its ability to deliver a composed, stress-free driving experience. Its cabin design and versatile layout create a supportive setting for busy professionals, families, or anyone seeking a tranquil retreat during daily routines.  Driving this Escape S is defined by quiet composure and smooth power delivery from its 1.5L EcoBoost engine paired to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The powertrain operates seamlessly, minimizing noise and vibrations whether accelerating onto the highway or gliding through city streets. Front-wheel drive helps maintain a light, nimble feel, while the four-wheel independent suspension absorbs bumps and imperfections for a refined, confident ride. The result is an SUV that makes every commute feel effortless, keeping fatigue at bay even on longer trips. EPA-estimated fuel economy of 28 mpg city and 34 mpg highway means you can enjoy extended journeys without frequent refueling stops.  Safety in the Escape S is integrated into the premium experience, with technology that works discreetly to protect without intrusion. Systems such as ABS brakes, electronic stability control, and traction control help maintain confidence in changing weather conditions. Key features like auto high-beam headlights and an exterior parking camera rear enhance visibility and awareness, supporting both urban maneuvering and nighttime travel. Multiple airbags, including knee and side impact units, are strategically placed for comprehensive occupant protection. The sense of security these systems provide allows you to focus on enjoying the drive, knowing you are surrounded by modern safety technology.  The feature set in this Escape S elevates everyday journeys with thoughtful amenities. Front bucket seats and a telescoping steering wheel adapt to various driver preferences, while speed-sensing steering and variably intermittent wipers add subtle convenience in changing conditions. The AM/FM stereo and six-speaker audio system deliver clear, immersive sound, complemented by steering wheel-mounted audio controls for seamless operation.  Among compact SUVs, the Escape S balances classic refinement and practical features against competitors like the Honda CR-V LX and Toyota RAV4 LE.  What premium materials are found inside the Escape S? The cabin features carefully selected Dark Earth Gray cloth upholstery and soft-touch controls, offering a tactile sense of comfort and support. How quiet is the SUV's interior? Thanks to well-engineered suspension and subtle sound insulation, road and wind noise are kept impressively low for the segment.  Experience classic refinement and elevated daily driving with the 2022 Ford Escape S at Dave Sinclair Ford. For more information or to schedule a test drive, call (314) 892-2600 or visit us at 7466 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63125.
